why: rc25: colour codes, tooltip wrap, font everywhere

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc25 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fix (big): the quest list beside the map showed pieces like cff3de3d0| inside objective lines and titles. The Persian-digits step also changed the digits INSIDE colour codes (3de3d0, ffd24a) and links, so the code stopped being a code. Digits now change only in the text between them.
Fix: the spell and talent tooltip description no longer jumps (rc22 sized the wrap from the tooltip's own width, which changes with every redraw; it is size based again, with the one-frame re-check kept).
New: General > Persian font in the whole game (off by default). The game's own fonts get our font (size x 0.92), so a Persian letter is never an empty box in chat, names, mail or friends. Off puts the originals back.
Includes rc7 to rc24.

Data from ForeverDB.net
